versions.subject: feat: new linux rules related to GobRAT malware (#4272)
versions.detection:
selection_process:
    Image|endswith: '/grep'
selection_architecture:
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - 'aarch64'
        - 'arm'
        - 'i386'
        - 'i686'
        - 'mips'
        - 'x86_64'
condition: all of selection_*
